# Brainboxes.IO .NET API — Full API Reference

> Complete public API surface for the Brainboxes.IO .NET library. For a concise overview, see [llms.txt](https://docs.brainboxes.com/llms.txt).

## Namespace: Brainboxes.IO

### Enums

```
IODirection [Flags]
  Input = 1        — Digital input
  Output = 2       — Digital output
  AInput = 4       — Analog input
  AOutput = 8      — Analog output

IOChangeTypes [Flags]
  NoChange = 0     — No state change detected
  RisingEdge = 1   — LOW→HIGH (input) or OPEN→CLOSED (output)
  FallingEdge = 2  — HIGH→LOW (input) or CLOSED→OPEN (output)
  Latched = 7      — Both rising and falling edges within one polling interval
  Undefined = 99   — Initial state, no previous value known

AIOChangeTypes
  Delta = 0        — Value changed by more than delta threshold
  Below = 1        — Value crossed below target
  Above = 2        — Value crossed above target
  Enter = 3        — Value entered target ± delta range
  Exit = 4         — Value left target ± delta range

IOType
  Digital          — Digital IO line
  Analog           — Analog IO line
  Relay = Digital  — Relay (programmatically identical to digital)

AnalogDataFormat
  Engineering      — Real-world units (volts, milliamps, degrees)
  PercentFSR       — Percentage of full-scale range
  TwosComplement   — Raw ADC two's complement
  Hexadecimal      — Raw ADC hexadecimal

TemperatureUnit
  Celsius          — Degrees Celsius
  Fahrenheit       — Degrees Fahrenheit

CounterMode
  CounterMode16Bits — 16-bit counter (0–65,535)
  CounterMode32Bits — 32-bit counter (0–4,294,967,295)

BBSerialPortType
  RS232            — RS-232 serial
  RS422_485        — RS-422/485 serial
```

### Delegates

```
ConnectionStatusChangedEventHandler(IConnection connection, string property, bool newValue) : void
DeviceStatusChangedEventHandler<TConnection, TProtocol>(IDevice<TConnection, TProtocol> device, string property, bool newValue) : void
IOLineChangedEventHandler(IOLine line, EDDevice device, IOChangeTypes changeType) : void
AIOLineChangedEventHandler(IOLine line, EDDevice device, AIOChangeTypes changeType, double previousValue, double currentValue) : void
```

---

## IConnection (interface)

```
Properties:
  bool IsConnected { get; }        — Whether there is an active connection
  bool IsAvailable { get; }        — Whether the device is reachable (ping for TCP, COM port exists for serial)
  int Timeout { get; set; }        — Read/write timeout in milliseconds
  Stream Stream { get; }           — Underlying data stream (available after Connect)

Methods:
  void Connect()                   — Open the connection
  void Disconnect()                — Close the connection

Events:
  ConnectionStatusChangedEventHandler ConnectionStatusChangedEvent — Fires when IsConnected or IsAvailable changes

Implements: IDisposable
```

## Connection (abstract base class)

```
Implements: IConnection

Properties:
  bool IsConnected { get; set; }      — Cached connection state
  bool IsAvailable { get; set; }      — Cached availability state
  int Timeout { get; set; }           — Read/write timeout (ms)
  Stream Stream { get; }              — Underlying stream

Methods:
  void Connect()                      — Connect (calls _connect, starts polling timer)
  void Disconnect()                   — Disconnect (calls _disconnect, stops polling)
  void Dispose()                      — Dispose (calls Disconnect)
  static Connection Create(string ip, int port = 9500, int timeout = 2000) : Connection
    — Factory: "COMx" → SerialConnection, otherwise → TCPConnection

Events:
  ConnectionStatusChangedEventHandler ConnectionStatusChangedEvent

Protected (for subclasses):
  abstract void _connect()
  abstract void _disconnect()
  abstract bool _computeIsConnectedValue()
  abstract void _newValueIsConnected()
  abstract bool _computeIsAvailableValue()
  abstract void _newValueIsAvailable()
  Stream _stream                      — Backing stream field
  int _timeout                        — Timeout backing field
  int _isAvailableCacheTimeoutMs      — Cache timeout for IsAvailable
  int _isConnectedCacheTimeoutMs      — Cache timeout for IsConnected
```

## TCPConnection

```
Extends: Connection

Constants:
  static readonly int DEFAULT_ASCII_PORT = 9500
  static readonly int DEFAULT_MODBUSTCP_PORT = 502

Constructor:
  TCPConnection(string ip = "192.168.127.255", int port = 9500, int timeout = 2000, int connectionTimeout = 20000)

Properties:
  readonly string IP                  — IP address
  int Port { get; set; }             — TCP port (cannot change while connected)
  int ConnectionTimeout { get; set; } — Socket connect timeout (ms, default 20000)
  int Timeout { get; set; }          — Read/write timeout (ms)
```

## SerialConnection

```
Extends: Connection

Constructor:
  SerialConnection(string comPort = "COM1", int baudRate = 9600, int timeout = 2000)

Properties:
  readonly string COMPort             — COM port name
  int BaudRate { get; set; }         — Baud rate (cannot change while connected)
  int Timeout { get; set; }          — Read/write timeout (ms)
```

---

## IProtocol (interface)

```
(Marker interface — base for IIOProtocol and ISerialProtocol)
```

## IIOProtocol (interface)

```
Methods:
  int GetAllDigitalLineStates(Stream stream) : int
    — Returns bitmask of all digital line states
  void SetAllDigitalOutputStates(Stream stream, int value) : void
    — Sets all digital outputs from bitmask
  int GetDigitalOutputLineState(Stream stream, IOLine line) : int
    — Returns state of single digital output (0 or 1)
  void SetDigitalOutputLineState(Stream stream, IOLine line, int value) : void
    — Sets single digital output
  int GetDigitalInputLineState(Stream stream, IOLine line) : int
    — Returns state of single digital input (0 or 1)
  int GetDigitalInputLineCount(Stream stream, IOLine line) : int
    — Returns transition count for input line
  void ClearDigitalInputLineCount(Stream stream, IOLine line) : void
    — Resets transition counter to zero
  int GetAllDigitalInputHighLatchedStatus(Stream stream) : int
    — Returns bitmask of high-latch registers
  int GetAllDigitalInputLowLatchedStatus(Stream stream) : int
    — Returns bitmask of low-latch registers
  double[] GetAllAnalogLineStates(Stream stream, int numberOfLines) : double[]
    — Returns array of analog values for all lines
  void SetAnalogLineState(Stream stream, IOLine line, double value) : void
    — Sets single analog output value
  string GetDeviceConfiguration(Stream stream) : string
    — Returns device XML configuration
  void SetDeviceConfiguration(Stream stream, string configuration) : void
    — Writes device configuration
  void SetDeviceConfiguration(Stream stream, string parameterName, string parameterValue) : void
    — Sets single configuration parameter
  void FactoryReset(Stream stream) : void
    — Resets device to factory defaults
  void Restart(Stream stream) : void
    — Restarts device
  string SendCommand(Stream stream, string command) : string
    — Sends raw command, returns response
```

## ISerialProtocol (interface)

```
Implements: ICloneable

Methods:
  void Send(Stream stream, string data) : void
    — Encode and send data
  string Receive(Stream stream) : string
    — Receive and decode data (blocks until terminator or timeout)
```

## ASCIIProtocol

```
Implements: IIOProtocol

Properties:
  AnalogDataFormat AnalogFormat { get; set; }  — Analog value format (default: Engineering)
  TemperatureUnit TempUnit { get; set; }       — Temperature unit (default: Celsius)
  CounterMode CountMode { get; set; }          — Counter mode (default: 16-bit)
  string deviceType                            — Device type string from configuration

(All IIOProtocol methods implemented)
```

## ModbusTCPProtocol

```
Implements: IIOProtocol

(All IIOProtocol methods implemented. FactoryReset, Restart, GetDeviceConfiguration,
SetDeviceConfiguration throw NotImplementedException.)
```

## DefaultSerialProtocol

```
Implements: ISerialProtocol

Properties:
  string TerminatingCharacters { get; set; }   — End-of-message characters (default: "\r")
  Encoding Encoding { get; set; }              — Character encoding (default: ASCII)

Methods:
  void Send(Stream stream, string data) : void
  string Receive(Stream stream) : string
  object Clone() : object
```

---

## Device<TConnection, TProtocol> (abstract base class)

```
Properties:
  string Label { get; set; }                   — User-definable label for debugging
  TProtocol Protocol { get; set; }             — Protocol instance
  TConnection Connection { get; }              — Connection instance
  bool IsConnected { get; }                    — Whether device is connected
  bool IsAvailable { get; }                    — Whether device is reachable

Methods:
  void Connect()                               — Connect to device
  void Disconnect()                            — Disconnect from device
  void Dispose()                               — Dispose (calls Disconnect)
  string Describe() : string                   — Detailed device description

Events:
  DeviceStatusChangedEventHandler<TConnection, TProtocol> DeviceStatusChangedEvent
```

## EDDevice

```
Extends: Device<IConnection, IIOProtocol>

Constructor:
  EDDevice()                                   — Default (no connection)
  EDDevice(IConnection connection)             — With connection, auto-selects protocol
  EDDevice(IConnection connection, IIOProtocol protocol) — With explicit protocol

Factory:
  static EDDevice Create(string ipAddress) : EDDevice
    — Connects, reads XML config, returns correct subclass

Properties:
  IOList<IOLine> IOLines { get; }              — All IO lines by logical number
  IOList<IOLine> Inputs { get; }               — Input lines only
  IOList<IOLine> Outputs { get; }              — Output lines only
  IConnection Connection { get; }              — Underlying connection
  IIOProtocol Protocol { get; set; }           — Protocol (ASCII or Modbus)
  int IOLineCacheTimeout { get; set; }         — Value cache timeout in ms (default: 10)
  bool IsConnected { get; }                    — Connection state
  bool IsAvailable { get; }                    — Device reachability

Methods:
  void Connect()                               — Connect and start IO polling
  void Disconnect()                            — Disconnect and stop polling
  string SendCommand(string command) : string  — Send raw ASCII command
  void FactoryReset()                          — Reset device to factory defaults
  void Restart()                               — Restart device
  string Describe() : string                   — Full device + IO state description

Events:
  IOLineChangedEventHandler IOLineChanged      — Any IO line changed
  IOLineChangedEventHandler IOLineRisingEdge   — Any line: rising edge
  IOLineChangedEventHandler IOLineFallingEdge   — Any line: falling edge
  IOLineChangedEventHandler IOLineCount        — Any line: count changed
  DeviceStatusChangedEventHandler DeviceStatusChangedEvent — Connection/availability changed
```

## IOLine

```
Properties:
  readonly int LogicalNumber                   — Line number 0–15 (as on device case)
  readonly int IONumber                        — IO number (e.g. DIN0, DOUT2)
  readonly IODirection IODirection             — Input, Output, AInput, or AOutput
  readonly IOType IOType                       — Digital or Analog
  string Label { get; set; }                   — User-definable debugging label
  int Value { get; set; }                      — Digital state (0/1). Get: cached, refreshes all lines if expired. Set: outputs only.
  double AValue { get; set; }                  — Analog value. Get: cached. Set: analog outputs only.
  int Count { get; }                           — Input transition count (inputs only)
  bool HighLatchedStatus { get; }              — High-latch register (inputs only)
  bool LowLatchedStatus { get; }              — Low-latch register (inputs only)
  IOChangeTypes MostRecentChangeType { get; }  — Last detected change type

Methods:
  int Toggle() : int                           — Invert digital output, returns new value
  void ClearCount()                            — Reset transition counter (inputs only)
  string Describe() : string                   — Full diagnostic description
  string ToString() : string                   — Short label + line info

Events:
  IOLineChangedEventHandler IOLineChanged      — This line changed
  IOLineChangedEventHandler IOLineRisingEdge   — This line: rising edge
  IOLineChangedEventHandler IOLineFallingEdge   — This line: falling edge
  IOLineChangedEventHandler IOLineCount        — This line: count changed

Analog Event Methods:
  void SubscribeToDeltaEvent(ref AIOLineChangedEventHandler function, double delta)
  void UnsubscribeToDeltaEvent(ref AIOLineChangedEventHandler function)
  void SubscribeToTargetEvent(ref AIOLineChangedEventHandler function, double target)
  void UnsubscribeToTargetEvent(ref AIOLineChangedEventHandler function)
  void SubscribeToTargetRangeEvent(ref AIOLineChangedEventHandler function, double target, double delta)
  void UnsubscribeToTargetRangeEvent(ref AIOLineChangedEventHandler function)
```

## ESDevice

```
Extends: Device<IConnection, ISerialProtocol>

Constructor:
  ESDevice(string ipAddress, int port1PortNumber = 9001, int timeout = 2000)
  ESDevice(string ipAddress, int port1PortNumber = 9001, int timeout = 2000, int numberOfPorts = 8, BBSerialPortType portType = RS232)

Factory:
  static ESDevice Create(string ipAddress, int port1PortNumber = 9001, int timeout = 2000) : ESDevice
  static ESDevice Create(string ipAddress, ISerialProtocol protocol) : ESDevice

Properties:
  IList<BBSerialPort> Ports { get; }           — Serial ports (indexed from 0)
  readonly int NumberOfPorts                   — Number of physical serial ports
  readonly BBSerialPortType PortType           — RS232 or RS422/485
  string IPAddress                             — Device IP address
  ISerialProtocol Protocol { get; set; }       — Sets protocol on all ports (cloned)
  bool IsConnected { get; }                    — True if any port is connected
  bool IsAvailable { get; }                    — Ping-based availability

Methods:
  void Connect()                               — Connect all ports
  void Disconnect()                            — Disconnect all ports

Events:
  DeviceStatusChangedEventHandler DeviceStatusChangedEvent
```

## BBSerialPort

```
Properties:
  int PortNumber { get; }                      — Port number (1-based)
  BBSerialPortType PortType { get; }           — RS232 or RS422/485
  IConnection Connection { get; }              — Underlying TCP connection
  ISerialProtocol Protocol { get; set; }       — Serial protocol for this port
  string Label { get; set; }                   — User label for debugging
  bool IsConnected { get; }                    — Connection state

Methods:
  void Connect()                               — Connect this port
  void Disconnect()                            — Disconnect this port
  void Send(string data)                       — Send data via protocol
  string Receive() : string                    — Receive data via protocol (blocking)
```

## Device Subclasses

### ED-Series
```
BB400(IConnection, IIOProtocol?)         — 8 DI + 8 DO (Modbus unsupported)
ED593(IConnection, IIOProtocol?)         — 8 thermocouple analog inputs
ED582(IConnection, IIOProtocol?)         — 4 RTD analog inputs
ED560(IConnection, IIOProtocol?)         — 4 analog outputs
ED549(IConnection, IIOProtocol?)         — 8 analog inputs
ED588(IConnection, IIOProtocol?)         — 8 DI + 8 DO
ED538(IConnection, IIOProtocol?)         — 8 DI + 4 relays
ED516(IConnection, IIOProtocol?)         — 16 DI
ED527(IConnection, IIOProtocol?)         — 16 DO
ED004(IConnection, IIOProtocol?)         — 4 DI + 4 DO + RS-232
ED204(IConnection, IIOProtocol?)         — 4 DI + 4 DO + RS-232
ED008(IConnection, IIOProtocol?)         — 8 DI + 8 DO
ED038(IConnection, IIOProtocol?)         — 3 DI + 3 relays
```

### ES-Series
```
ES246(string ip, int port = 9001, int timeout = 2000)   — 1-port RS-232
ES257(string ip, int port = 9001, int timeout = 2000)   — 2-port RS-232
ES313(string ip, ...)   — 1-port RS-422/485
ES320(string ip, ...)   — 2-port RS-422/485
ES346(string ip, ...)   — 1-port RS-232
ES357(string ip, ...)   — 2-port RS-232
ES413(string ip, ...)   — 1-port RS-422/485 (PoE)
ES420(string ip, ...)   — 2-port RS-422/485 (PoE)
ES446(string ip, ...)   — 1-port RS-232 (PoE)
ES457(string ip, ...)   — 2-port RS-232 (PoE)
ES511(string ip, ...)   — 1-port RS-232 (compact)
ES522(string ip, ...)   — 2-port RS-232 (compact)
ES551(string ip, ...)   — 1-port RS-422/485 (compact)
ES571(string ip, ...)   — 2-port RS-422/485 (compact)
ES701(string ip, ...)   — 1-port RS-232 (wireless)
ES279(string ip, ...)   — 2-port RS-232 (isolated)
ES842(string ip, ...)   — 4-port RS-232
```

---

## Stream Classes

### BBStream

```
Extends: Stream (wraps an inner stream with thread-safe locks)

Fields:
  object streamReadLock   — Lock for synchronising read operations
  object streamWriteLock  — Lock for synchronising write operations

(Standard Stream overrides: Read, Write, Flush, Length, Position, CanRead, CanWrite, CanSeek, Seek, SetLength)
```

### BBNetworkStream

```
Extends: BBStream (wraps a NetworkStream, sets ownsSocket = false)

Constructor:
  BBNetworkStream(Socket socket)
```

---

## TCP Port Reference

| Port | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| 9500 | ASCII protocol (ED-series default) |
| 502  | Modbus TCP protocol |
| 9001 | ES-series serial port 1 |
| 9002 | ES-series serial port 2 |
| 9003+| ES-series serial ports 3+ |
| 80   | Device XML configuration page |
